sources.title: fromziro/Qana-mini-5M · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Qana-mini-5M is intended for architecture research, representation analysis, educational experiments, and controlled comparisons. It is a compact base model rather than an instruction-tuned assistant.

sources.title: Qana-mini-5M - 开源模型 - fromziro - OpenCSG - Causal Lm - Safetensors
sources.snippet: Qana-mini-5M 是由 fromziro 推出的开源人工智能模型，主要应用于Causal Lm，OpenCSG提供高速免费下载服务，支持模型推理、训练、部署全流程管理，助力AI开发者高效工作。

sources.title: fromziro (FromZero) - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Orez - Tiny (1.3M), Small (5M), Medium (12.4M), Large (30M): A family of Small Language Models ranging from 1.2M to 30M parameters. Each of them will be massively overtrained on a minium of 1000+ tokens per parameter.
